title: WarrantyTerm - Data API
description: Represents warranty terms defining the labor, parts, and expenses covered, along with any exchange options, provided to rectify issues with products. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

Code.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Code.description: A code or other identifier associated with this warranty term.

EffectiveStartDate.description: Date on which the warranty term became available for use. Possible values are: InstallDate ManufactureDate PurchaseDate

ExchangeType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExchangeType.description: The type of exchange offered. Possible values are: AdvanceExchange Loaner ReturnExchange

ExpensesCoveredDuration.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExpensesCoveredDuration.description: The duration for which expenses are covered.

ExpensesCoveredUnitOfTime.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ExpensesCoveredUnitOfTime.description: The unit in which expenses covered duration is measured. Possible values are: Days Months Weeks Years

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Defines whether the warranty term is active.

IsTransferable.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsTransferable.description: Defines whether the warranty can be transferred to a new owner.

LaborCoveredDuration.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LaborCoveredDuration.description: The duration for which labor is covered.

LaborCoveredUnitOfTime.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
LaborCoveredUnitOfTime.description: The unit in which labor covered duration is measured. Possible values are: Days Months Weeks Years

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the warranty term was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the warranty term was last viewed.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update

PartsCoveredDuration.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PartsCoveredDuration.description: The duration for which parts are covered.

PartsCoveredUnitOfTime.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
PartsCoveredUnitOfTime.description: The unit in which parts covered duration is measured. Possible values are: Days Months Weeks Years

Pricebook2Id.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Pricebook2Id.description: The ID of the price book item associated with this warranty term.

WarrantyDuration.description: The duration of the warranty offered by this term.

WarrantyTermName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
WarrantyTermName.description: The name of the warranty term.

WarrantyType.description: The type of warranty. Possible values are: Repair Standard Supplier

WarrantyUnitOfTime.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
WarrantyUnitOfTime.description: The unit in which the warranty duration is measured. Possible values are: Days Months Weeks Years

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **WarrantyTermChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
